html:
Hon Tam Island, often referred to as the green gem of Nha Trang Bay one of the most beautiful bays in the world is a perfect destination for travelers seeking a relaxing yet exciting one-day island escape. This guide provides a complete review of the Hon Tam Island one-day tour, including transportation, best time to visit, ticket prices, must-try activities, and essential travel tips to ensure an unforgettable experience in 2026.

Overview Of Hon Tam Island, Nha Trang

Hon Tam Island, also known as Thuy Kim Son Island, is one of the largest and most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay, covering an area of more than 110 hectares. When viewed from above, the island resembles a giant green silkworm resting peacefully in the middle of the sea this unique shape is the origin of its name.

The island is famous for its unspoiled natural beauty, featuring lush tropical forests, long stretches of soft white sand, and crystal-clear turquoise waters. With its tranquil atmosphere, Hon Tam offers an ideal retreat away from the hustle and bustle of the city. At the same time, modern resorts and well-developed tourism facilities make it suitable for both relaxation and entertainment.

Originally a pristine and little-known island, Hon Tam has been thoughtfully developed since the early 21st century, focusing on sustainable tourism that balances high-end services with environmental preservation.

How To Get To Hon Tam Island

To reach Hon Tam Island, travelers first need to go to Cau Da Port, located approximately 6 kilometers from Nha Trang city center.

Getting To Cau Da Port

  • Taxi or motorbike taxi: Convenient and time-saving, especially for groups or travelers with luggage.

  • Public bus (Route No. 4): A budget-friendly option with fares ranging from 7,000 to 10,000 VND per trip.

  • Motorbike rental: Ideal for travelers who prefer flexibility and independence.

From Cau Da Port To Hon Tam Island

  • Speedboat (canoe): The fastest option, taking only 7–10 minutes. This is usually included in one-day tour packages.

  • Wooden boat: A slower but more economical choice, with a travel time of around 20–25 minutes.

During peak seasons, booking transportation or a tour package in advance is highly recommended.

Best Time To Visit Hon Tam Island

Hon Tam Island enjoys a mild climate all year round, with an average temperature of around 26°C.

  • Best season: From March to September, when the weather is sunny, the sea is calm, and conditions are ideal for water activities.

  • Low season: Late dry season or early rainy season, offering fewer crowds and more affordable prices.

For a lively atmosphere, weekends and holidays are ideal. If you prefer peace and relaxation, visiting on weekdays is a better option.

Hon Tam Island Ticket Prices (Updated 2026)

Ticket packages typically include round-trip speedboat transfers and access to island facilities.

  • Basic Island Package:
    From 400,000 – 500,000 VND per adult

  • Mud Bath Package:
    From 600,000 – 750,000 VND per adult

  • All-Inclusive Package (Most Popular):
    Includes speedboat transfers, mud bath, seafood buffet lunch, and beach activities
    From 900,000 – 1,200,000 VND per adult

Prices may vary depending on season and promotions, so advance booking is recommended.Top Experiences On Hon Tam Island

Relaxing On Hon Tam Beach

With over one kilometer of white sandy beach and clear blue waters, Hon Tam Beach is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and relaxing. Lifeguards are always on duty, ensuring a safe experience for visitors.

Visiting Hoang Hoa Village

Hoang Hoa Village is a traditional village with more than 100 years of history. Here, visitors can explore traditional wooden houses, learn about local culture, enjoy traditional music, and take part in handicraft experiences such as pottery making.

Mud Bath And Wellness Experience

Hon Tam is home to one of the largest mud bath complexes in Vietnam. The natural mineral mud helps improve skin health, reduce stress, and promote overall relaxation an essential experience for wellness lovers.

Water Sports And Adventure Activities

  • Flyboarding

  • Parasailing

  • Kayaking

  • Sea walking to explore coral reefs

  • Mini golf course

These activities offer a wide range of experiences, from calm and relaxing to thrilling and adventurous.

Check In At Hon Tam Pier

Hon Tam Pier is a popular photo spot and one of the best places to watch the sunset on the island. The golden light reflecting on the sea creates a truly romantic and memorable scene.

Final Thoughts

The Hon Tam Island one-day tour is an excellent choice for travelers who want to combine pristine beaches, luxury relaxation, and exciting activities in a short time. With stunning natural scenery, high-quality services, and diverse experiences, Hon Tam Island promises a memorable highlight in any Nha Trang travel itinerary.
